title: &aBeasts and Companions
subtitle: Alex's Mobs, Mowzie's Mobs, mutants, odd allies, pets and guards.

quests.title: The Animal Dictionary
quests.subtitle: Alex's Mobs
desc: &eAlex's Mobs&r puts more than ninety creatures into the world, from roadrunners to cachalot whales. Some are friendly, some can be tamed, some will eat you.
Craft the &eAnimal Dictionary&r (see JEI). Each creature has a page: where it lives, what it drops, how to tame it.

quests.title: A Friend in the Savanna
desc: The savanna around the first village is home to &eelephants&r. Tame one (its dictionary page tells you how) and it will carry you and a chest of cargo.
Wildheart players: this is where your beast-taming starts.

quests.title: Trophies of the Wild
desc: Many Alex's creatures drop parts for gear: &eRoadrunner Boots&r (fast on sand), the Crocodile Chestplate, the Tarantula Hawk Elytra, the Squid Grapple and more.
Make the Roadrunner Boots from feathers of the quick desert birds.

quests.title: The Void Worm
desc: Something enormous lives in the void under the End islands. The &eVoid Worm&r can be called up there (its dictionary page says how), and it splits into pieces when hurt.
Kill every piece. Its parts make the &eDimensional Carver&r, a portal you can carry.

quests.title: Umvuthi, the Sunbird
quests.subtitle: Mowzie's Mobs
desc: &eMowzie's Mobs&r adds handcrafted mini-bosses (you may already have met the Ferrous Wroughtnaut). In the savanna, masked Umvuthana guard their chief in a hidden &egrove&r.
Defeat &eUmvuthi&r. Kill the masked followers first; the chief calls the sun down on you.

quests.title: Tongbi, the Sculptor
desc: On high peaks, &eTongbi&r sets a challenge: climb the stone pillar it raises while it hurls rocks at you.
Reach the top to win the Geomancer's gear. Optional for climbers.

quests.title: Frostmaw
desc: In snowy lands a giant white ape sleeps, often clutching an &eIce Crystal&r. Wake it and it fights with ice breath and ground slams.
Keep moving to dodge the ice breath, and bring a ranged weapon. Frostbinders will want that crystal.

quests.title: The Naga
desc: Along ocean cliffs, the winged sea serpent &eNaga&r dives at anyone on the shore and spits poison.
Hit it while it's grounded after a dive. Its fangs make a poison dagger.

quests.title: Mutant Monsters
desc: Rarely, a zombie, skeleton, creeper or enderman comes back huge: a &eMutant&r. They're mini-bosses that roam the night.
The &eMutant Zombie&r gets back up after it falls unless you burn its body. Fight it with fire nearby.

quests.title: Bones of a Giant
desc: The &eMutant Skeleton&r fires volleys of arrows and leaves its bones behind.
Its ribs, skull and limbs craft into &eMutant Skeleton armour&r.

quests.title: Strange Companions
quests.subtitle: Companions!
desc: &eCompanions!&r adds odd allies and their homes: the Teddy Tower, the Monkey Temple, Baba Yaga's hut, a factory and a traveller's tent.
Hatch a &eCroissant Dragon&r from its egg, collect copper, Nether and End coins, and see what the Frog Bonanza does with them. Visit a Teddy Tower.

quests.title: The Shade Altars
desc: Three altars (Sword, Maw and Bat) summon &eShade&r bosses when you activate them with &eCrystallized Blood&r.
Defeat the &eShade Maw&r. Optional, and not a fight for one.

quests.title: Pets That Come Home
quests.subtitle: Redomesticate
desc: &eRedomesticate&r makes pets sturdier. Give a pet a &epet bed&r: if it dies, it respawns there instead of being lost.
A &eCommand Drum&r orders your pets to follow, stay or wander. A &eDeed of Ownership&r hands a pet to a friend, and a lost pet finds its way to a &eWayward Lantern&r.

quests.title: Enchanted Companions
desc: Redomesticate adds &epet enchantments&r: Health Boost, Fireproof, Healing Aura, Chain Lightning, Ore Scenting and more. Their books turn up in chests.
Look for &eTethered Teleport&r: waystones don't carry pets in this pack, but a tethered pet follows you anywhere, even across dimensions.

quests.title: Captain of the Guard
quests.subtitle: Guard Villagers
desc: Village guards fight raids and monsters. Give them better swords, crossbows and armour once they trust you (open a guard's inventory by interacting with it); armourers and weaponsmiths repair their gear.
With Hero of the Village, ring the village &ebell&r to order every guard nearby to follow you, or set patrol points for them.

quests.title: Keeper of Beasts
desc: You've faced the wild's worst and made friends with its best. The corruption twists creatures; you've seen what the untouched ones can be.
Next: dragons (see the Dragons chapter).
